headline: Chord Acquires Zenlytic to Expand Enterprise AI and Commerce Capabilities
summary: Chord acquired AI-powered business intelligence platform Zenlytic, doubling its revenue and adding customers such as Verizon, J.Crew, Domino's, and Stanley Black & Decker.
why: Consolidation in the enterprise software and data analytics sectors allows platforms to scale customer bases and integrate advanced artificial intelligence features.

impacts.name: Chord
impacts.why: Chord is expanding its portfolio through an acquisition.
